title: House Robber Maximum Sum - Solution
intuition: You are a professional robber planning to rob houses along a street. Each house has a certain amount of money stashed. Return maximum rob amount.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: For house i, you either rob it (money[i] + max_rob(i-2)) or skip it (max_rob(i-1)).
